caption: The drawing depicts a single ceramic jug positioned in the center of the composition. The jug is rendered in light brown tones with subtle shading to indicate its three-dimensional shape and the play of light on its surface. The jug has a rounded body that tapers toward the base and a narrower neck that flares outward at the rim. The handle extends from the neck to the shoulder on the left side of the jug. There is a blue decorative motif painted on the upper front of the jug, featuring swirling lines and oval shapes. The background is plain and off-white, making the jug stand out clearly. There is a small, hand-written inscription beneath the jug.
title: Pitcher
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
